title: 1권 8유닛 장면 · 4
prompt: Children's picture-book illustration, hand-drawn 2D style, thick soft dark-brown outlines, flat bright cheerful colors with a light paper texture and gentle watercolor shading, rounded friendly shapes. No photo-realism, no 3D render look. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene with a simple uncluttered background and a calm, simple sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. The characters must look exactly like the ones in the attached character sheet (left to right: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Grumble). Scene: The umbrella has landed softly by the round garden door in the wall. A friendly grown-up rabbit with a mustache, a green cap and a watering can — Uncle, Bun's uncle and the garden's gardener — holds the little door open and winks as if he has always known the secret. Bun and Hedgie look up at him with open mouths; Pip sits on the umbrella, glowing. Three new letter trees (S with sun, seal and soup fruits; T with turtle, tomato and tooth fruits; U with umbrella, up-balloon and uncle fruits) stand by the door. Grumble has run up beside the trees and stares at his lantern: it has lit itself again all on its own and now shines brighter than ever, and he holds it away from his face in surprise. Hidden in the picture: the uncle with the watering can, the red umbrella. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers.
